postings.title: Free Home Energy Savings Workshop
postings.sourceLabel: Sustainable Westchester & Mid-Hudson Regional Clean Energy Hub
postings.shortSummary: Free Home Energy Savings Workshop - covers energy bill reduction, weatherization, appliance electrification, HEAP, Empower+, heat pumps, and more
postings.fullDescription: Free Home Energy Savings Workshop — Thursday, October 22, 2026, 6:30 PM at the White Plains Public Library (Community Room); hosted by Sustainable Westchester & Mid-Hudson Regional Clean Energy Hub in partnership with the City of White Plains; covers energy bill reduction, weatherization, appliance electrification, HEAP, Empower+, heat pumps, and more; free DIY Energy Savings Kit and light dinner included with registration at sustainablewestchester.org/the-home-energy-savings-workshop/ — questions: 914-242-4725 ext. 122 or hello@sustainablewestchester.org.

postings.title: Port Chester Obedience Dog Training Club Open House
postings.locationName: PCOTC ground floor; 220 Ferris Ave, White Plains, NY
postings.shortSummary: Free Open House at PCOTC (220 Ferris Ave, White Plains) – Saturday, Aug 22, 2026, noon–4 pm: bring your dog and try agility, nose/scent work, obedience, rally, and puppy training demos at no cost.
postings.fullDescription:
FREE fun activities for you & your dog on Saturday, August 22, 2026 from noon to 4 pm

Are you curious about what tricks you can teach your dog, or how to train a puppy?
Have you wanted to try out a dog sport, like agility, nose/scent work, obedience or rally?
Come and visit our training club for a free, fun-filled afternoon trying all of these activities with your dog!
